The ParkingLot includes a method to get a PriceList, which has attributes for prices for different durations.

The ClubMember class details automatic discounts for parking sessions.
The ClubMember class has a method checking for eligibility for free parking, suggesting first session discounts.
The ReportingService class can generate an annual summary report.
Instructions in the reporting mechanisms suggest inclusions of parking lot details and payments for vehicles.
Report descriptions include considerations for city order and total amount sequencing.
The reporting function details offering PDF and XML formats.
The ReportingService can generate a Club Growth report showing monthly membership details.
The report includes new member numbers, cumulative totals, and monthly growth percentages.
Guidelines specify that club growth reports are ordered monthly.
